title: Track workflow ownership context for stage chats
goal: Allow /chat to know whether the current agent chat belongs to a workflow stage and show workflow ownership as scope only.
requirements: workflow ownership must not become the primary /chat subject
workflow scope format in default UI is just workflow
normal pool agents show pool scope
overall workflow states are not forced into a stage agent status line
validation: Workflow chat binding registers stage chats with scope=workflow and state=working.
Workflow events update stage chat state to idle/waiting/done/failed.
